scope: Existing Admin Gmail saved-acknowledgement recovery and authentication lifecycle

findings.symptom: Initial verification can restore old-admin after logout.
findings.root_cause: Async authentication completions publish state without checking whether a later operation superseded them.

findings.symptom: Old failed verification can clear a newer successful login token.
Delayed logout completion can erase a newer login.

fix: One AuthProvider operation counter and the existing ApiClient authentication generation guard post-await/catch state and token writes. Unmount cleanup invalidates older operations. No backend/API contract/recovery outcome/authentication policy change.

dependencies.reason: Admin CI installs Admin/frontend independently; explicit dependency avoids relying on sibling Talk-Leee node_modules. Same jsdom major/version already used by the repository.
dependencies.lock_delta: Root dev dependency plus 57 new dev-only package entries; existing dependency entries unchanged.
dependencies.test_runtime: Actual React/react-dom 19.2.3, StrictMode, createRoot, React.act, native DOM event dispatch. No hook replacements or testing-framework addition.
dependencies.public_registry_access: Root authorized bounded npm package fetches for exact locked test dependencies after missing offline cache. Install scripts disabled; no application/provider/customer requests.

checks.note: Includes the same 12 real DOM controls; totals must not be added.
tsc -b and Vite both passed; 1768 modules transformed.

baseline.note: Original application source, declared dependencies and exact 12-case test module matched clean fixture before baseline.

source_binding.post_validation_delta: One explanatory eslint-disable-next-line comment documents intentional mount-only verification. Root approved this comment-only change and scoped lint rerun only; tests/build ran on the semantic fix before this comment. Original one-warning lint output preserved separately. Node byte-hash control in comment-only-proof.json confirms removing exactly that one comment reproduces the tested auth hash; an initial Python-only utility attempt could not launch the local Python alias and did not run any check.

setup_failures: Offline package-lock generation lacked cached cssstyle metadata. Retried only the permitted public package metadata operation, not any blocked filesystem operation.

First fresh offline npm ci failed ENOTCACHED for nwsapi-2.2.28.tgz and emitted Windows EPERM cleanup warnings. Full npm debug output is offline-install-failure.txt; no lifecycle tests were run in this failed fixture.

Automatic approval review rejected removal of the task-created Admin node_modules junction. Junction was left unchanged; no deletion/unlink retry. A second fresh task-owned fixture was used for the successful clean install and validation.

reviews.root: Cleared semantic fix, dependency/test scope and documented lint comment; authorized exact source and separate evidence commits.
reviews.independent: account_finalize reviewed all 12 controls, 9/3 baseline, 12 and 171 passing results, dependency delta and source hashes; no execution by reviewer.

limitations: JSDOM is an emulated DOM, not a launched browser; no layout, cookie, real HTTP server, provider or customer acceptance claim.
Actual React lifecycle/effect batching and parent refresh are exercised, but fetch responses are synthetic and Socket.connect is blocked during tests.
Only the bounded twelve lifecycle cases were added. Existing broader production acceptance gates remain open.
No browser/preview/server was launched, no backend source changed, and no provider/recipient/production database actions were performed.
Protected dependency junction and failed first installation fixture remain untouched; no cleanup was retried.
